title: What they said at the time

clips.q: After four and a half intense and wonderful years as CEO of Groupon, I’ve decided that I’d like to spend more time with my family. Just kidding – I was fired today.
clips.who: **Andrew Mason**, letter to employees, Feb 28, 2013, as published by The Next Web[^24]

clips.q: I started Groupon to get Eric to stop bugging me to find a business model.
clips.who: **Andrew Mason**, letter to prospective stockholders in the IPO prospectus, Nov 2011[^1]

clips.q: Groupon’s board turned down offers of around $6 billion from Google.
We hate that we offended people, and we’re very sorry that we did — it’s the last thing we wanted.
clips.who: **Andrew Mason**, on the Super Bowl ads, quoted by NPR, Feb 11, 2011[^22]

clips.q: My biggest regrets are the moments that I let a lack of data override my intuition on what’s best for our customers.
Our financial statements contain a statement regarding a substantial doubt about the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern.
clips.who: **Groupon, Inc.**, risk factor heading, annual report for 2022, filed Mar 16, 2023[^13]

clips.q: After testing Deals for four months, we’ve decided to end our Deals product in the coming weeks.
We’ve learned a great deal from the daily deals business and will look for ways to apply these lessons in the future
clips.who: **Amazon spokesperson**, on closing Amazon Local, Oct 30, 2015[^26]

clips.q: Our 2025 results represent a landmark achievement in Groupon’s multi-year transformation, as we returned to growth in both billings and revenue for the first time in a decade
